title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements

summary: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws.
takeaways: Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself.
PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems.
Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation.
